# MSI European notebook warranty extension — SRC-0250

## Sources

- https://euservice.msi.com/fr/warranty-extension/fr/
- https://download-2.msi.com/archive/mnu_exe/pdf/2021/extended-warranty-service-manual.pdf

## Evidence

MSI publishes a European notebook warranty-extension route. The French program lists one additional notebook year at €219 and two at €349, covering normal-use defects after the standard warranty. The extension must be bought in the same country as the original product. This proves that MSI support extension exists, but the French price cannot be transferred to a Netherlands or Belgian SKU. Exact eligibility, scope and total for `B2WI-034NL` or `B2WI-035BE` remain UNKNOWN until confirmed for the purchase country.
